name: calculate_pot_odds_and_mdf

Pure read-only, deterministic calculation with zero side effects; accepts `pot` and `bet` in any consistent unit (chips, dollars, or BBs) and optional `outs` (0 to 20), returning all metrics in a single JSON object (<1 KB). Use this tool when a player faces a specific bet into a known pot and needs required calling equity, MDF defense frequency, or call EV. Do NOT use this tool when no bet is specified and the user only wants Turn/River/Flop-to-River draw completion percentages and Rule-of-4/2 error for N outs (call `calculate_draw_outs`), nor for hand-vs-hand card simulations (call `calculate_poker_odds`).

name: calculate_bankroll_risk_of_ruin

Pure read-only, deterministic closed-form calculation with zero side effects; if `winrate_bb_per_100 <= 0`, returns `riskOfRuinPct: 100` with an explanatory warning that non-positive winrates guarantee eventual ruin. Use this tool when sizing a total poker bankroll in buy-ins or computing probability of going broke at a given stake. Do NOT use this tool to simulate confidence intervals, downswing probability, or expected profit over a finite sample of N hands (call `simulate_poker_variance` instead).

Do NOT use this tool for No-Limit geometric stack-to-pot sizing (call `calculate_spr_sizing`) or standard calling pot odds (call `calculate_pot_odds_and_mdf`).

previous_pot.description: Center pot before current street betting or previous pot in BBs/dollars (default: 1.5).

name: simulate_poker_variance

name: calculate_draw_outs
description: Compute exact hypergeometric poker draw completion probabilities—Flop-to-Turn (`outs / 47`), Turn-to-River (`outs / 46`), and combined 2-card Flop-to-River (`1 - ((47 - outs)/47) * ((46 - outs)/46)`)—alongside Rule of 4 & 2 approximation error and required break-even pot odds ratio for `outs` (1 to 21) on a given `street` (`flop` or `turn`). Pure read-only, deterministic combinatorics calculation with zero side effects; returns exact percentages, odds ratios, and permalink (`https://smarter.poker/tools/outs-calculator`) in a compact JSON object (<1 KB). Use this tool when a player knows their number of clean outs (e.g., 8-out straight draw, 9-out flush draw, 15-out combo draw) and wants exact Turn/River hit probabilities and Rule of 4/2 comparison. Do NOT use this tool when a specific pot and facing bet size are given to evaluate call EV or MDF (call `calculate_pot_odds_and_mdf` instead).

outs.description: Number of clean unseen outs from 1 to 21 (default: 9).

street.description: Current street: "flop" (2 cards to come, 47 unseen) or "turn" (1 card to come, 46 unseen, default: "flop").

annotations.title: Calculate Hypergeometric Draw Probabilities & Rule of 4/2 Error
